enonce_intro_markdown:
The probability density function $f$ of a continuous random variable $X$ is given by

$$f(x) = \begin{cases} kx, & 0 < x < 1 \\ k + 1 - x, & 1 \le x \le 2 \\ 0 & \text{elsewhere.} \end{cases}$$

Find
incertitudes: Question 4 : la branche centrale est imprimée « $k + 1 - x$ » ; elle est transcrite telle quelle. Avec $k = 1$ la densité devient $2 - x$ sur $[1, 2]$, continue en $x = 1$ ($f(1) = k$ des deux côtés) et nulle en $x = 2$, ce qui confirme la lecture.

questions.corrige_markdown:
A density must integrate to 1 over its support:

$$\int_0^1 kx\,dx + \int_1^2 (k + 1 - x)\,dx = 1.$$

$$\int_0^1 kx\,dx = \left[\frac{kx^2}{2}\right]_0^1 = \frac{k}{2}$$

$$\int_1^2 (k + 1 - x)\,dx = \left[(k + 1)x - \frac{x^2}{2}\right]_1^2 = (2k + 2 - 2) - \left(k + 1 - \frac{1}{2}\right) = k - \frac{1}{2}$$

$$\frac{k}{2} + k - \frac{1}{2} = 1 \;\Longrightarrow\; \frac{3k}{2} = \frac{3}{2}.$$

**$k = 1$.** Then $f(x) = x$ for $0 < x < 1$ and $f(x) = 2 - x$ for $1 \le x \le 2$: a triangular density, non-negative everywhere, symmetric about $x = 1$.

With $k = 1$, on $\left[\frac{3}{2}, 2\right]$ the density is $f(x) = 2 - x$:

$$P\left(X > \frac{3}{2}\right) = \int_{3/2}^{2} (2 - x)\,dx = \left[2x - \frac{x^2}{2}\right]_{3/2}^{2} = (4 - 2) - \left(3 - \frac{9}{8}\right) = 2 - \frac{15}{8}.$$

**$P\left(X > \dfrac{3}{2}\right) = \dfrac{1}{8} = 0.125$.** (Check: it is the area of a right triangle with base $\frac{1}{2}$ and height $f(\frac{3}{2}) = \frac{1}{2}$, that is $\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2}$.)

$$E(X) = \int_0^1 x \cdot x\,dx + \int_1^2 x(2 - x)\,dx = \left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1 + \left[x^2 - \frac{x^3}{3}\right]_1^2.$$

$$\left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1 = \frac{1}{3}, \qquad \left[x^2 - \frac{x^3}{3}\right]_1^2 = \left(4 - \frac{8}{3}\right) - \left(1 - \frac{1}{3}\right) = \frac{4}{3} - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{2}{3}.$$

**$E(X) = \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{2}{3} = 1$.** (Consistent with the symmetry of the density about $x = 1$.)
